notes: Media-only poll: shares transcribed from the România TV broadcast graphic (sociopol-doc-004). Fieldwork dates, sample size, mode and margin of error come from the România TV article that embeds the graphic (sociopol-doc-003, https://www.romaniatv.net/sondaj-sociopol-pe-cine-prefera-romanii-la-alegerile-parlamentare-psd-conduce-detasat_8633323.html): "Sondajul Sociopol a fost realizat în perioada 20 – 22 noiembrie, prin metoda CATI, pe un eșantion de 1000 de persoane. The article gives the fieldwork dates without a year; the year 2024 is fixed by the article itself (dated 24 Nov 2024, about the 1 Dec 2024 parliamentary election). published_date is the article's declared publication time (2024-11-24T12:44:21+00:00); the broadcast date of the graphic is not stated. question_wording is the question printed on the graphic (in capitals, as shown). The article text gives USR 15%; the graphic shows 13%, and the graphic value is used. Population, geographic coverage, question type and weighting were not stated. No client is stated for this poll: the article says it was broadcast by România TV; its sentence that a poll was commissioned by România TV refers to the earlier Sociopol presidential poll (4–8 Nov 2024) quoted in the same article. The share base is not stated; the shares shown sum to 100 with no undecided or non-response option, so they are recorded as expressed_option; the size of that base was not published.
